set.body: Acceptance criteria: after the golden workflow exists, measure a realistic long recording and identify actual allocation and memory bottlenecks; compare nested sample values, columnar storage, recording views, and chunked streaming with equivalent completed work; decide whether Machine needs a small emission algebra; introduce byte-based preflight for dense transport and recurrence allocations; record JVM and Scala.js applicability, fixture, environment, work counts, peak memory, and decision rationale. No wholesale storage rewrite proceeds without this evidence.
set.title: Post-trust profile: storage, emission, and byte-budget decisions
